source.title: CSS Grid Layout Module Level 1, 2025 Candidate Recommendation Draft
source.status: Candidate Recommendation Draft; work in progress

profile: one auto-repeat and one or more integer fixed-repeat groups in one axis; fixed-repeat pattern entries are finite nonnegative LengthPx or minmax(finite nonnegative LengthPx, finite nonnegative Fraction)

scenes.flexCheck: six 1fr tracks freeze at their 24px minimum; the remaining 28px is shared by the two 1fr tracks
one occupied auto-fit track and two fixed-repeat tracks share the 192px remaining after two 4px gutters
three 1fr tracks freeze at 24px; the remaining 32px is shared by the two 1fr tracks
one occupied auto-fit track and two fixed-repeat tracks share 112px after two 4px gutters
seven auto-repeat tracks freeze at 24px; two 12px prefix tracks freeze at their minimum; the 2fr suffix tracks resolve to 22px each
the 0fr auto-repeat tracks freeze at 24px; the sole 0.5fr fixed track resolves to 16px from a 32px flex unit, leaving 16px unused in the 200px container

comparison.usedTrackCssomTolerance: Chrome reports fractional used sizes at 1/64 CSS px increments; compare exact integer sizes and collapsed zeroes, and accept at most 1/64 CSS px for non-integer sizes
comparison.independentRuntimeTolerance: 0.02 CSS px for f32 layout/frame comparisons

controls.profileResult: CSS parser rejects invalid min track breadth

controls.computedInput: four finite Fraction(1e38) tracks; their expanded f32 flex-factor sum is non-finite
controls.profileResult: reject with UnsupportedComputedGridValue before calling Taffy

controls.computedInput: one finite 1fr fixed track plus one finite 1e38fr auto-repeat pattern whose maximum feasible expansion exceeds the finite f32 aggregate
controls.profileResult: reject with UnsupportedComputedGridValue before calling Taffy

controls.computedInput: MinMax { min: LengthPx(-1), max: Fraction(1) }, NaN or infinity in either typed operand
controls.profileResult: reject with UnsupportedComputedGridValue and preserve node/property context
accept only if Stylo computed projection yields MinMax { min: LengthPx(20), max: Fraction(1) }; reject unresolved Calc breadth

resourceBoundaries.fixedRepeatGroupComponents: 9999 fixed groups plus one auto-repeat at 10000 list components is the largest possible passing component input; 10000 fixed groups plus auto-repeat is rejected at 10001 components
resourceBoundaries.projectedTrackDescriptors: fixed repeat count 9998 with one MinMax pattern plus one ordinary track and one auto-repeat pattern track gives 10000 ComputedGridTracks descriptors; count 9999 gives 10001 and must fail before Taffy. The auto-repeat is represented once at this projection stage.
resourceBoundaries.taffyExpandedTracks: the actual auto-repeat expansion remains separately capped at MAX_GRID_TRACKS=10000; the projection descriptor boundary is not a claim that this template count equals its used CSS repetition count
resourceBoundaries.lineMetadata: exercise computed expanded metadata at 1048576 bytes and 1048577 bytes; the former is allowed when all other gates pass, the latter fails closed
resourceBoundaries.reservationFailure: inject MinMax-path reservation failures for fixed-repeat metadata, track vector, and expanded line-name storage; require no partial result and successful next call
